tasks.title: Armour can deflect bullets while letting rockets break it, and homing rockets steer at the armour plate instead of parking inside a hull
tasks.description:
Plan §2.2.4 (decisions X3, X7, X12). Add global/components/armor_query.gd (ArmorQuery.deflects(area, hit_box): deflects_hit(hit_box) if present, else today's is_armored()). bullet.gd, homing_missile.gd and warhead_missile.gd call it (one line each, keeping their wrapper names). homing_missile._fly_to_target steers at locked_target.homing_point(global_position) when the method exists. bullet.gd gains is_high_impact() -> bool (returns unlimited_pierce: the player's Sniper Shot). Add global/components/armor_plate.gd (ArmorPlate: HurtBox layer 512 mask 96 with EMPTY accepted_damage_types, Health, Sprite). The plate does NOT connect received_damage; it classifies each HitBox in its HurtBox's area_entered: breaks_on(hb) = ROCKET or the projectile's is_high_impact() -> health.decrease(hb.damage); otherwise emit deflected(hit_box). deflects_hit(hb) = not is_alive() or not breaks_on(hb) - so a plate broken this frame consumes nothing (a homing volley's later rockets go on to the next plate). Signals broken(plate: ArmorPlate), deflected(hit_box: HitBox); is_alive, set_glow; break = close hurtbox deferred, hide, ExplosionEffect, emit, queue_free. Prove it on a fixture armoured entity (tests/helpers) with real player bullets, Sniper Shots and rockets in tests/integration/test_armor_query.gd. The space station implements neither new method and must not change.

tasks.title: An armoured enemy can hurt the player on touch at all times without ever exploding or dying from the contact
tasks.description:
Plan §2.6.3 (X8, X13). Append ARMOR to ContactProfile.Mode (value 4, so serialized ints do not shift): armable, armed at setup(), emits contact_made while armed, never detonates, never harms its owner; set_armed(false) closes the hitbox. Add @export shove_speed := 0.0: on each armed touch with shove_speed > 0, call target.apply_knockback(dir * shove_speed) duck-typed (target = the touched hurtbox's parent, dir = owner -> target). The Assault PlayerFighter already honours apply_knockback. OpenSpacePlayerShip gains the override it lacks: apply_knockback(impulse): velocity += impulse (never PlayerBase.apply_knockback_motion, which clamps to the Assault bounds). Extend tests/unit/test_contact_profile.gd and the Open Space ship's test file. Update the class doc table.

tasks.title: The Bomber angles in, lays mines, bombs or a pursuit bomb across where the player is heading, then escapes on an arc
tasks.description:
Plan §2.4 items 1-8 (X11) and §2.9.4. Two leads: the MINE wall uses an UNDAMPED lead on the bomber's own timeline, t_wall = clamp(approach time left + (run_length/2)/run_speed + mine_arm_delay + wall_margin 0.4, 0, mine_horizon 3.0), so the wall is armed where the player will be when they arrive; gravity bomb and pursuit aim keep the damped lead (0.6, horizon 1.2). Ordnance choice: MINE when 150 <= |v| <= 440 (a boosting player gets a pursuit bomb), else GRAVITY if close, else PURSUIT, with rng jitter. Bombing line: perpendicular to the path for mines, angled pass for bombs; Assault clamp of every point to inner_rect().grow(-64). DubinsPath lead-in arriving along the line, RE-PLANNED from a fresh prediction every 0.25 s until RUN entry and frozen there. RUN at 170: mines placed BY DISTANCE around the crossing point s* = (P - pos) . dir, 70 px apart with a 30 px arc bow, each ejected so it comes to rest exactly on its planned point; gravity release; pursuit launch. ESCAPE turn_toward arc, Open Space REPOSITION loop, Assault budget deferral to RUN's end. StateLight ARMED during RUN. Dual-mode specs in test_bomber.gd, including the live-player placement assertion and the bomber's attack-in-budget row through a real WaveManager.
